extra.final_summary: The data had three issues: (1) Category labels had extra spaces and case variants (e.g., ' Accessories', ' Electronics'), which were normalized to 'Accessories' and 'Electronics'; (2) Two rows had negative Quantity values (-4 and -5), which violate the rule that Quantity must be at least 1 (positive units sold), so those rows were excluded; (3) The Price column contained dollar amounts as text (e.g., '$12.00'), which were converted to numbers. One row (row 1) had an incorrect Revenue value (480 instead of 48), which was corrected by recomputing it as Quantity * Price. After these fixes, the analysis shows that 84 units were sold in the East, 75 in the North, 101 in the South, and 79 in the West.
